item.title: 5-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and father return to Minnesota from ICE facility in Texas
item.description: Five-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and his father, who were detained by immigration officers in Minnesota and held at an ICE facility in Texas, have been released following a judge’s order. They have returned to Minnesota, according to Texas Rep. Joaquin Castro.

item.title: Balanced effort powers WBS Penguins to road win over Phantoms
item.description: The Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins uncorked four goals in the third period to pull away from the Lehigh Valley Phantoms for a 6-2 win on Sunday afternoon at PPL Center.

item.title: IN FRAME: Legacy sequels — nostalgia slop or meaningful addition?
Luzerne County officials seek Veterans Affairs director
item.description: Luzerne County is seeking a new Veterans Affairs director, according to an online posting.

item.title: LOOK BACK: Wanamie mine fire cost seven lives in 1907
item.description: As soon as the fire started in the No. 3 slope of the Lehigh & Wilkes-Barre Coal Co. mine in the village of Wanamie on Feb. 8, 1907, all hope was lost for seven miners.

item.title: BEYOND THE BYLINE: Time to predict who will win Super Bowl LX
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — This is an alert — Super Bowl picks of area prognosticators will be printed in next Sunday’s Times Leader — the Feb. 8 edition.

item.title: LEGISLATIVE ROUNDUP: DEP fights hunger in PA, invests $4.1M in food recovery infrastructure
item.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) is investing $4,125,923 in Commonwealth nonprofits — such as food banks, food pantries, and soup kitchens — through the Food Recovery Infrastructure Grant (FRIG) Program to help reduce wasted food and fight hunger in Pennsylvania.

item.title: Local roundup: Crestwood girls basketball hands Hazleton Area first division loss
item.description: Keira Dougherty came through with 25 points and Crestwood delivered one of the biggest wins of the WVC girls basketball season on Sunday, knocking off Hazleton Area 63-51 on the road.

item.title: Braving the cold: How to safely exercise outdoors during winter
item.description: Exercising outdoors has numerous health benefits, but winter weather may disrupt normal routines.

item.title: LeBron’s record-setting All-Star streak extends to 22 years
item.description: LeBron James is an All-Star again, extending his record streak of selections.
